retrieval: Reuse exact saved redacted questions and context; no retrieval changes or new embeddings
calibration: Use the original classifiers and exact thresholds; no training or selection
routing: Code combines the separate self-check, validated citations, unchanged retrieval signals and frozen calibrated wrongness
citationPolicy: Retrieved IDs only; preserve pre-repair invalid counts; reject ambiguous/unknown IDs before scoring
missingBaseline: Gemma 4B plain50 prior-method replay is generated locally and labelled as replayed, never as a previous saved run
stopAfter: Stage 1; Stage 2 retrieval completeness requires a later instruction
